notes.title: Update 1.2 is here!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663236/77d7ad3ced7232a7f81de90d94b8eaf770a99156.png"][/img][/p][h1]Wordy Rain update 1.2 is here![/h1][p]Hey Wordy friends! The 1.2 update is live and it's celebrating the last bits of summer here in the Northern Hemisphere with these new additions:[/p][list][*][p][b]New scene: Lake House - [/b]You can choose a new background scene for your game, "Lake House". I created this scene specifically as an ode to a favorite summer vacation spot for my family here in the Pacific Northwest called Iron Springs. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New feature! The Wordy Drop - [/b]there's a new [i]seasonal feature [/i]in Wordy Rain called the Wordy Drop: ten secret words related to a theme. This season's theme is "summer", so your mission is to find all ten summer-themed words and unlock them in the menu. Steam players get a Steam achievement for finding all ten! But once the season is done, that's it. Get those words while you can![/p][/*][*][p][b]Powerup changes and additions - [/b]the Swap powerup has been changed to work a bit more like you wanted it to (you drag the letter to swap it). And since swap is now just one powerup, I've added a new one: shuffle the board. This one gets granted on leveling up in Challenge mode, and every 1000 points in other modes. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you love the update and that it's a nice reminder for you of our summer days this year![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2 Beta is up for testing!
notes.content: [p]Hey Wordy Friends! I've made an update to the Beta branch: the content for the 1.2 update is there and ready to test! Be aware that this is [b]beta content and therefore could have bugs or other instabilities. [/b]But if you want a peek and want to help test, that's where to go![/p][p][/p][p]If you don't know how to enable beta content, it's easy:[/p][list][*][p]Right click the Wordy Rain game in your Library[/p][/*][*][p]Go to "Properties..." and then "Betas"[/p][/*][*][p]Change the dropdown in the upper right to be the Beta Testing branch[/p][/*][*][p]Restart Steam and the game [i]should[/i] update right away with the new content[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you get an error right away it might be that Steam still needs to get the content. [/p][p][/p][h2]What's New? Summer stuff, that's what![/h2][list][*][p][b]New background scene: [/b]there's a new background scene called the Lake House with some new effects![/p][/*][*][p][b]New feature: the Wordy Drop![/b] Check out the new Wordy Drop feature in the main menu: ten secret words on a theme. Find all 10 words to earn the Steam Achievement for that event! These will change once in a while, so get that achievement while you can![/p][/*][*][p][b]New powerup and some powerup changes: [/b]The swap mechanic now works a bit more like people expect it to, and it's just one swap now, not two separate directions. And now there's a new powerup in the third slot: shuffle the whole board. Earn that one every time you level up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Remember, this is beta content -- it's up for bug finding and testing, so [b]please send any bug reports to shadowdogdev@gmail.com ![/b][/p]

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Small patch for the 1.1 update:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with the swap powerup somehow stalling out at level 10+ (thanks, George!)[/p][/*][*][p]Game over screen now always shows the score and level you reached, not just when you hit a new high in those.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.1 Update is here!
notes.content: [p]Hey friends! I've got an update with a few new things and some fixes for you! Here's the list:  [/p][list][*][p][b]New visual effects when you level up, and a little change when you hit big levels![/b] Look for some cute visual effects whenever you level up, and check out the level change when you hit bigger levels that show different effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fix: the double-block bug shouldn’t happen anymore, or at least very, very rarely[/p][/*][*][p]Swap powerup mechanic changes: in Cozy Mode the swap powerups now get filled up by making words instead of by a timer. All other modes: the swap powerups will still fill up over time, but more slowly, but making words will add to them.[/p][/*][*][p]Some needed sound additions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for UI possibly causing some input problems on the letter grid [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I'm working on the next set of updates -- I know the swap powerup is finicky to use so I'm working on that, but also on some exciting additions that I think people will like. Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: First Update: new background scene!
notes.content: [p]Hey Wordy Rain players! A few of you jumped on buying my game out of the gate, and I'm so thankful! I've made a first update to the game to fix a couple of issues big and small, and also added a background scene so you have a new one to choose. One of the things I plan to do is regularly add new scenes, themes, sound packs, etc. so this is just dipping a toe in the water of those updates![/p][p][/p][p]1.0.1 Changes:[/p][list][*][p]New background scene: "Night Birches"[/p][/*][*][p]New music for "Night Birches" scene when you play in Challenge mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a major scoring bug when you manually spawn new blocks -- it was mathing wrong and jumping you WAY too high a level when you did it. That's been fixed. [/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Happy playing![/p]
